Attached: 1 image

BleachBit has released version 6.0.6 across Linux, Windows, and macOS, bringing performance upgrades and expanded cleaning capabilities.

Startup is now faster due to delayed module loading, and file wiping speed has been improved by switching to 512 KiB blocks.

The update adds support for Docker Desktop, the Helium browser, and several developer tools, alongside important permission fixes for Linux and Windows.
